name: Villafranca Sicula (Italy)
description: Vertical bicolour of red and yellow, charged at the centre with the crowned municipal arms of Villafranca Sicula (yellow and black pales) within branches, with the inscription Comune di Villafranca Sicula in white arched above.
history: Municipal flag of Villafranca Sicula, a comune in Sicily; Italian municipal arms, gonfaloni and flags are granted by decree of the President of the Republic on the advice of the Government's heraldry office.

features.role: Villafranca Sicula arms — yellow and black pales, crowned, within branches
inscription Comune di Villafranca Sicula arched above the arms
